services.desc: A few years back, we introduced our Christmas light helicopter tours, and they have quickly become our most sought-after experience!✅ Depart from Toledo Suburban Airport✅ Enjoy an exciting, climate-controlled helicopter ride✅ Covers approximately 40 miles✅ Showcases the nighttime beauty of NW OhioJourney highlights:✅

blurb: Guests can take helicopter tours over Toledo including downtown river tours, fall color tours, and Valentine's Day special flights. Tours provide aerial views of landmarks and natural scenery. The company also offers an instrument rating course for helicopter pilots.
extraNote: All tours non-refundable · Half-down deposit required to book, non-refundable · Full payment required a day before tour · Weather cancellations offer refund or reschedule; deposit retained as flight credit, no refund · $50 rebooking fee within 7 days; $100 additional if no-show · Cancel for any reason insurance optional at booking · Toledo Suburban Airport, main entrance with the red door · Fall color tours on select weekends in fall
